name: Olivani Lite
ingredients: Vegetable oils (olive oil 16%), water, salt, emulsifiers (soy lecithin, 471), preservative (202), acidity regulator (270), flavour, colour (160a).
origin: Made in New Zealand from imported and local ingredients.
note: Underside of the tub only; the front of pack was not photographed. The product name is taken verbatim from the label's own comparison footnote ('Olivani Lite (55 g/100 g) contains 33% less total fat than regular salted New Zealand butter'). Protein, carbohydrate and sugars are printed as '<1.0 g' and trans fat per serving as '<0.1 g' - not numbers, so those cells are omitted. Polyunsaturated (12.9 g/100 g) and monounsaturated (26.9 g/100 g) are on the label but have no allowed key. Categorised 'dairy' for the chiller aisle it sits in - it is a dairy-free spread. 500 g is derived from 50 servings x 10 g.
